_notes: UQM 0.8.0's own AI (intel.c's computer_intelligence, cyborg.c's tactical_intelligence, ship_intelligence and the rest, and the ships' own intelligence_func: ilwrath.c's ilwrath_intelligence, sis_ship.c's sis_intelligence) flying ships in its own battle engine, recorded by the program battle.json and battle-ships.json are (tools/extract/golden/battle.c; see their notes for the engine, the sheets, the masks, the ships and the frames), as an encounter runs a battle: battle.c's ProcessInput calls each side's frameInput in turn, side 0's ships first, and a side the AI flies has intel.c's computer_intelligence for it, as battlecontrols.c's computer handlers have.

input: as battle-ships.json's, and ai: who flies each side, null the keys (the steps' keys for a side the AI flies are ignored), or the AI at a rating (PlayerControl: standard STANDARD_RATING, good GOOD_RATING, awesome AWESOME_RATING, the story's enemy's, restart.c; side 1 COMPUTER_CONTROL, side 0 CYBORG_CONTROL as UQM's Cyborg option makes it); earth: PROBE_ILWRATH_ENCOUNTER set, with IN_ENCOUNTER the Earth fight's rule, in which ilwrath_intelligence doesn't cloak.

inputs: each frame's BATTLE_INPUT_STATE for each side as its frameInput returned it (1 left, 2 right, 4 thrust, 8 weapon, 16 special), -1 where it wasn't called (no ship with an element; the first frame, before DoBattle). frames: as battle-ships.json's; the AI's random draws (TurnShip turning a half circle, Entice dodging) are among each frame's draws, named by UQM's function. crew_enlisted and bomb_carrier: as battle-ships.json's.
